correctness.rationale: Unique clearing follows from the contraction modulus max row sum 9/10 in the witness and from each row sum <1 in the general model. Default sets decrease as proportional external assets increase. For one and two banks, a unique top marginal recipient cannot leave the argmax and later reenter, because the index vector is constant in the all-default phase and a solvent recipient has derivative zero. The three-bank witness has rational exact clearing branches with boundaries 42/95, 126/61, 6; fixed-set gradients (416/105,374/105,114/35), (55/48,35/24,0), (1,0,0), yielding strict sequence 1,2,1. Exact rational checker recomputes clearing through all 8 hypothesized default sets and tests injections independently. Threshold tie behavior is not asserted.

originality.rationale: The new narrowly framed assertion is the minimal three-bank dimension for reentry of the unique marginal-cash-injection maximizer as all exogenous assets scale upward; explicit exact connected witness. Demange (2015) proves the fixed-default-set sensitivity and presents non-monotone targeting for changing total bailout size (a different intervention parameter), and Li et al. value.rationale: A smallest-network criterion for policy target reentry is a structurally motivated boundary for the value of interventions as financial conditions recover: a two-bank rescue target cannot regain strict priority once overtaken, but a fully interlinked three-bank system can. The explicit rational thresholds and exact witness are interpretable benchmark data. It is distinct from merely evaluating published threat indices at a fixed default set and does not claim downstream regulatory prediction.
